text:
Miranda (CS): Heads-up — multiple trial tenants reported stalled activations and webhook 5xxs this morning. Need a short, personalized outbound, an offer (enablement + credit), and plan to log renewal risk. Draft below.

Ken (Support): How many tenants and what parts failed?

Miranda (CS): 10 tenants (mix SMB + two mid-market). Failures: webhook callback retries and final indexation stuck in the queue, window 05:40–06:12 UTC. No customer data exposure. List: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted/onboard-4135

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-0814 created — onboarding-queue-regression. Assigned eng-runtime.

Lina (CS Manager): Draft outbound (short, personalize for mid-market):

"Hi [Customer name],

Apologies — this morning some onboarding tasks were delayed which slowed activation. Root cause: an autoscaler routing change that briefly routed bursts to an overloaded pool. We reverted the change and processed the backlog.

What we'll do for you: 1) a complimentary 45-minute onboarding concierge session (screen share + checklist), 2) a one-time credit equal to 15% of measured onboarding usage during the window (prorated), and 3) option to extend the trial by 5 days for impacted accounts.

No customer data was exposed. Reply to book a priority slot and we'll CC your account rep.

Feedback form: https://redwood.internal/cs/onboard-feedback

Thanks, Miranda on behalf of Redwood Inference"

Ravi (Solutions Eng): For enterprise/mid-market add an exec-summary header and a short RCA blurb: cause = autoscaler route preference change without saturation guard; fix = rollback + rate-limit guard + new raid (queue-depth) alert + one-off backlog drain.

Omar (Sales Ops): Credit flow — prorated 15% by default for trials. If CS flags an account with high renewal risk, we'll offer 25% + trial extension. I'll prepare memos and mark AMs to CC.

Ken (Support): Send plan: mid-market first at 09:30 UTC with AM cc and a calendar stub for concierge slots; SMB batch at 11:00 UTC. Include local time conversion for high-touch notes.

Miranda (CS): Add a 2-line "checks you can run" snippet to include in the message:
- verify webhook endpoint returns HTTP 200
- check queue depth: `curl -s https://internal/metrics/onboard?tenant_id=... | jq .queue_depth`

Lina (CS Manager): I'll flag renewal-risk candidates in Salesforce and create follow-ups. Capture outbound copy in the account timeline.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Posting the non-technical postmortem blurb now; will attach eng-runtime's full RCA once available.

Ken (Support): Sent mid-market batch at 09:33 UTC. CCs to AMs included. :white_check_mark:

Lina (CS Manager): Two mid-market replies asking for immediate concierge slots. Scheduling and logging in SF.

Ken (Support): SMB batch sent at 11:02 UTC. Low reply volume so far.

Omar (Sales Ops): Credit memos prepared and queued for billing; flagged two accounts for 25% per Lina's renewal-risk notes.

Miranda (CS): Closing coordination — capture responses in account health tracker, add renewal-risk follow-ups, and attach the formal RCA when eng-runtime publishes it. We'll run a 48-hour feedback pulse to collect qualitative onboarding friction. Reopen if any escalations.
